text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, after running through the 
rough-and-tumble path of the Twinkle 
Series with Inari One, I felt like we had 
reached a turning point—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
“—This is the exact definition of 'the 
time is ripe'! You've still got that 'Hot 
Spring Trip Ticket', right?”

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Then let's get a move on! To our 
Grand Victory Hot Springs Celebration 
Festival!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Aahh! That was a great bath! They even had 
fruit milk ready, pure perfection! All my 
fatigue and everything just blew right 
away!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Well, there's still plenty of time until 
dinner, maybe I'll take a quick stroll 
around—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? What the heck's this? "Hell 
Cauldron Bath located in the Annex"?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hold on, hold on, hold on! As a true-blue 
child of Edo, I can't just ignore this! A 
Hell Cauldron... Just how boiling hot is 
this bath!?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Boss! Sorry, but go on ahead without me! 
I'm gonna hop into this one!
choice_data_list: Make sure not to stay in too long!
Make sure you don't stay in too long!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Big Sis! Sorry, go on ahead back without 
me! I'm gonna hop into this one!"
choice_data_list: Make sure not to stay in too long!
Make sure you don't stay in too long!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Heh, who do ya think you're talkin' to!? 
I'm the one and only Inari One! I'll enjoy 
that hot bath to the fullest!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Get outta here... You ain't half bad, you 
hellish cauldron bath, you...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Inari One enjoyed the hell 
cauldron bath a bit too much and ended up 
feeling lightheaded...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Laying down for a bit really helped 
me get my energy back...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Hup... there!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
No way, I'm not gonna let this great 
chance end with me getting dizzy and 
sleeping it off!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Next, let's cool off in the evening 
breeze. Come on, let's go, Boss!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Next, let's cool off in the evening 
breeze. Come on, let's go, Sis!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Phew... It really is quiet around here. 
Not a speck of hustle and bustle in sight.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Haha, not at all. Something like this is 
nice once in a while.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
A festival's only possible when you have 
peaceful everyday life to begin with, 
right? ...It's the same thing.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...Every single day with you up until now 
has been as lively and fun as a festival. 
However—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Taking it slow and quietly enjoying the 
night breeze like this once in a while... 
...is pretty tasteful, and I think it's 
necessary too."

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
For us to walk this long road together, 
you know.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
……Hm? Do you hear something coming from 
over that way?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From the direction Inari One was looking, 
a faintly familiar sound could be heard. 
Could this be—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: This isââââfestival music!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, whoa! Looks like some kinda 
festival just kicked off over there! We 
can't just sit around here!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Boss! Let's head out right now! My blood's 
pumpin' already!!
choice_data_list:
W-What happened to our peaceful everyday 
life?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Big Sis! Let's go right now! My blood is 
pumping!!"
choice_data_list:
W-What happened to our peaceful everyday 
life?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
That's all done and dusted! For a true Edo 
girl like Inari, every day's a festival! 
Look—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—With Inari One pulling me by the hand, 
the two of us run toward the sound of the 
festival music.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: It's festival time, baby--!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Heheh—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a precious moment where I felt an 
irreplaceable bond with Inari One...
